name: ret_21
meaning: 21-session total return to t
rationale: Short-term reversal: one-month winners tend to give back part of the move (liquidity provision).
available: close of signal date t (prices up to and including t)
missing: missing if either endpoint has no quote (no price filling)
extremes: kept raw; model sees the cross-sectional percentile rank

name: ret_63
meaning: 63-session total return to t
rationale: Intermediate momentum / reversal.
available: close of signal date t (prices up to and including t)
missing: missing if either endpoint has no quote
extremes: kept raw; model sees the cross-sectional percentile rank

name: mom_252_21
meaning: Return from t-252 to t-21 sessions (12-1 momentum)
rationale: Classic cross-sectional momentum, skipping the reversal month.
available: close of signal date t (prices up to and including t)
missing: missing if either endpoint has no quote
extremes: kept raw; model sees the cross-sectional percentile rank

name: vol_63
meaning: Annualized std of daily returns over 63 sessions
rationale: Low-volatility anomaly; also a risk control.
available: close of signal date t (prices up to and including t)
missing: requires >= 57 of 63 daily returns
extremes: kept raw; model sees the cross-sectional percentile rank

name: drawdown_252
meaning: Price / trailing 252-session max - 1
rationale: Distance from 52-week high (anchoring; George-Hwang).
available: close of signal date t (prices up to and including t)
missing: requires >= 200 quotes in the window
extremes: kept raw; model sees the cross-sectional percentile rank

name: log_dollar_volume_63
meaning: log median(close x volume) over 63 sessions
rationale: Liquidity / size; also used for the investability screen.
available: close of signal date t (prices up to and including t)
missing: requires >= 40 observations
extremes: kept raw; model sees the cross-sectional percentile rank

name: log_mcap_proxy
meaning: log market-cap proxy from the entry quarter's selection
rationale: Size effect.  Known at the selection close <= t.
available: selection_date of the entry quarter (<= t by construction)
missing: left missing; model imputer uses the training median and adds an indicator
extremes: known proxy errors (e.g. APDN) are rank-bounded, not altered

name: net_margin
meaning: quarterly net income / revenue
rationale: Profitability (quality).
available: available_date = filing_date + 1 calendar day (placeholder filings: fiscal_date + 120 days)
missing: missing if denominator <= 0, inputs missing, or statement older than 550 days
extremes: kept raw; model sees the cross-sectional percentile rank

name: book_to_market
meaning: total equity / market-cap proxy of the entry quarter
rationale: Value effect.  Proxy mixes vendor share/price bases: treat as noisy.
available: available_date = filing_date + 1 calendar day (placeholder filings: fiscal_date + 120 days)
missing: missing if denominator <= 0, inputs missing, or statement older than 550 days
extremes: kept raw; model sees the cross-sectional percentile rank

name: roa_yoy_change
meaning: operating ROA minus operating ROA of the same quarter a year earlier
rationale: Profitability trend: improving firms keep outperforming (slow reaction to fundamentals). Same-quarter comparison removes seasonality.
available: available_date = filing_date + 1 calendar day (placeholder filings: fiscal_date + 120 days); the year-ago / trailing quarters must each have been available no later than the current statement, otherwise missing
missing: missing if the year-ago quarter (fiscal date within 20 days of one year earlier) is absent, a required input is missing or <= 0, or the statement is older than 550 days
extremes: kept raw; model sees the cross-sectional percentile rank

name: revenue_growth_yoy
meaning: revenue / revenue of the same quarter a year earlier - 1
rationale: Sales growth as a fundamental-momentum measure.
available: available_date = filing_date + 1 calendar day (placeholder filings: fiscal_date + 120 days); the year-ago / trailing quarters must each have been available no later than the current statement, otherwise missing
missing: missing if the year-ago quarter (fiscal date within 20 days of one year earlier) is absent, a required input is missing or <= 0, or the statement is older than 550 days
extremes: kept raw; model sees the cross-sectional percentile rank

name: asset_growth_yoy
meaning: total assets / total assets a year earlier - 1
rationale: Asset-growth anomaly (Cooper-Gulen-Schill): fast balance-sheet growth predicts lower returns.
available: available_date = filing_date + 1 calendar day (placeholder filings: fiscal_date + 120 days); the year-ago / trailing quarters must each have been available no later than the current statement, otherwise missing
missing: missing if the year-ago quarter (fiscal date within 20 days of one year earlier) is absent, a required input is missing or <= 0, or the statement is older than 550 days
extremes: kept raw; model sees the cross-sectional percentile rank

name: net_issuance_yoy
meaning: log(shares outstanding / shares outstanding a year earlier)
rationale: Net issuance anomaly (Pontiff-Woodgate): issuers underperform, repurchasers outperform.  Vendor share counts are on one split basis (checked on AAPL 2014), so the ratio is split-neutral; the few residual jumps near split ratios (about 0.3% of rows near x2) are kept and rank-bounded.
available: available_date = filing_date + 1 calendar day (placeholder filings: fiscal_date + 120 days); the year-ago / trailing quarters must each have been available no later than the current statement, otherwise missing
missing: missing if the year-ago quarter (fiscal date within 20 days of one year earlier) is absent, a required input is missing or <= 0, or the statement is older than 550 days
extremes: kept raw; model sees the cross-sectional percentile rank

name: earnings_yield_ttm
meaning: sum of the last four quarters' net income / market-cap proxy of the entry quarter
rationale: Earnings-based value; less distorted by intangibles than book value.  Requires four quarters spanning 255-290 days.  Same proxy noise as book_to_market.
available: available_date = filing_date + 1 calendar day (placeholder filings: fiscal_date + 120 days); the year-ago / trailing quarters must each have been available no later than the current statement, otherwise missing
missing: missing if the year-ago quarter (fiscal date within 20 days of one year earlier) is absent, a required input is missing or <= 0, or the statement is older than 550 days
extremes: kept raw; model sees the cross-sectional percentile rank

name: filing_age_days
meaning: days since the statement became available
rationale: Information staleness; lets models discount old ratios.
available: available_date = filing_date + 1 calendar day (placeholder filings: fiscal_date + 120 days)
missing: left missing; model imputer uses the training median and adds an indicator
extremes: kept raw; model sees the cross-sectional percentile rank

name: availability_imputed

rationale: Transparency flag for the +120 day placeholder rule.
available: available_date = filing_date + 1 calendar day (placeholder filings: fiscal_date + 120 days)
